result.boundary: Default-off resident Nanite depth and explicit DefaultLit bindings with optional resident base-color textures write actual legacy GBuffer A-E and scene color using UE EncodeGBuffer. Exact prepass visibility and page attributes determine pixels; equal read-only depth preserves nearer ordinary meshes. Equal explicit materials share bins of up to 64 instance/slot members, one GPU-compacted union of 8x8 tiles and one indirect draw. Per-pixel member transforms remain distinct. Zero-fallback fixtures verify this subset; no automatic UMaterial bindings, arbitrary graphs, lightmaps, normal maps, Substrate, full Nanite shading bins, streaming or complete-scene acceptance. Two-phase resident HZB uses previous/current minimum depth pyramids and recovers disocclusion in the same frame; main geometry is currently rasterized again to build one consistent final visibility table. Resident LOD uses real view pixel error, with independent CPU cut/raster comparisons; streaming LOD remains unimplemented.
